name: leanvox_generate
description: Generate speech audio from text using Leanvox TTS API. Returns a URL to the generated audio file.

text.description: Text to convert to speech (max 10,000 chars)

model.description: TTS model. 'standard' for fast/cheap, 'pro' for highest quality with emotion control

voice.description: Voice ID (e.g. 'af_heart', 'emma', 'james'). Use leanvox_list_voices to see options.

name: leanvox_stream
description: Stream generated speech audio to a local file. Use for longer texts where you want audio saved to disk. Only supports MP3 format.

text.description: Text to convert to speech (max 10,000 chars)

outputPath.description: Local file path to save the audio (e.g. './output.mp3')

model.description: TTS model. 'standard' for fast/cheap, 'pro' for highest quality

name: leanvox_dialogue
description: Generate multi-speaker dialogue audio. Each line can use a different voice. Great for podcasts, conversations, and interviews.

text.description: Text for this speaker to say

name: leanvox_list_voices
description: List available TTS voices. Optionally filter by model ('standard' or 'pro'). Returns voice IDs, names, and preview URLs.

name: leanvox_transcribe
description: Transcribe an audio file with speaker diarization. Can return immediately with async STT job metadata when forceAsync is true and wait is false.

filePath.description: Path to the audio file to transcribe

features.description: Features to enable. Default: ['transcript', 'diarization']. Add 'summary' for summary with action items.

numSpeakers.description: Hint for expected number of speakers

forceAsync.description: Schedule as a background STT job even for short files

wait.description: Poll scheduled jobs until complete. Set false to return job metadata immediately.

name: leanvox_get_job
description: Get status and available result metadata for an async Leanvox STT or TTS job.

name: leanvox_list_jobs
description: List async Leanvox jobs, optionally filtered to STT or TTS.

name: leanvox_check_balance
description: Check the current Leanvox account balance and total spending. Returns balance in cents and formatted dollar amounts.
